# Clinical Indicators

This folder groups the specific clinical quality indicators and medical concepts used to monitor and evaluate healthcare performance within the corpus. It currently houses the metrics utilized by the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) to track acute high-risk abdominal surgery in Denmark. The contained sub-folder details the definitions, performance standards, and regional variations for interventions ranging from early antibiotic administration to postoperative mobilization, while also documenting significant methodological and definitional shifts between the 2023 and 2024 reporting periods.

## Pages

- [[topics/clinical-indicators/acute-surgery/index|Acute Surgery]] — The specific quality indicators, medical interventions, and outcome metrics used by the AKDB to monitor acute high-risk abdominal surgery, including significant definitional changes between the 2023 and 2024 reporting periods.
